# biznetgio_neolite_pro_products (Data Source)

Daftar product NEO Lite Pro (pakai buat isi `product_id` di `biznetgio_neolite_pro_vm`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "biznetgio_neolite_pro_products" "all" {}

output "first_product_id" {
  value = data.biznetgio_neolite_pro_products.all.products[0].product_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
